name: Light Control (Mantra)
one_line: Planned Mac app that drives a Neewer Bluetooth LED light with smooth colour transitions and a local API, linked to Meditation Room and, through Webcam Recorder, to a Sony camera.
does: Find the light over Bluetooth LE and expose every function it has
Change colour and colour temperature with smooth transitions
Calibrate the light from the picture of a Sony Alpha 7 V, reached only through Webcam Recorder
Breathe the light slowly at brainwave pace (alpha, theta) to set a mood in the room
Follow the colours of the Meditation Room visualization, and be driven by it
tasks: set the room light colour or colour temperature
make the room light follow the meditation visuals
pulse the light slowly in alpha or theta rhythm

edges.label: room drives the light; the light follows the visualization colours
the only road to the Sony camera
Queen can drive it through the API
optional, through the G815 Lights API only, never direct
